### Urban Edge Properties Invites You to Join Its Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Conference Call


September 16, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s203.q4cdn.com/606204294/files/doc_news/Urban-Edge-Properties-Invites-You-to-Join-Its-Third-Quarter-2026-Earnings-Conference-Call-2026.pdf)


NEW YORK--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Urban Edge Properties (NYSE: UE) announced today that it will release its third quarter earnings prior to the market open on Wednesday, October 28, 2026. The Company will host an earnings conference call and audio webcast on October 28, 2026 at 8:30 AM ET.


All interested parties can access the earnings call by dialing 1-877-407-9716 (Toll Free) or 1-201-493-6779 (Toll/International) using conference ID 13762478 or by using the following link for instant telephone access to the event:[Call Me](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fcallme.viavid.com%2Fviavid%2F%3Fcallme%3Dtrue%26passcode%3D13720762%26h%3Dtrue%26info%3Dcompany%26r%3Dtrue%26B%3D6&esheet=54605291&newsitemid=20260916146758&lan=en-US&anchor=Call+Me&index=1&md5=e9a81a715daba1fe59e5f613c7658326) . The call will also be webcast and available in listen-only mode at this link:[UE Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Conference Call](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fviavid.webcasts.com%2Fstarthere.jsp%3Fei%3D1774389%26tp_key%3Db8266d30e6&esheet=54605291&newsitemid=20260916146758&lan=en-US&anchor=UE+Third+Quarter+2026+Earnings+Conference+Call&index=2&md5=28c92bfa8a44e06cd2b4aaeab5a2b776) , or on the investors page of our website:[www.uedge.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.uedge.com&esheet=54605291&newsitemid=20260916146758&lan=en-US&anchor=www.uedge.com&index=3&md5=29840995dbbbf620f0cb584d0a327436) .


If you are unable to participate in the live call, a replay will be available at the webcast link above, or on the investors page of our website for one year following the conclusion of the call. A telephonic replay of the call will also be available starting Wednesday, October 28, 2026 at 11:30 AM ET through Wednesday, November 11, 2026 at 11:59 PM ET by dialing 1-844-512-2921 (Toll Free) or 1-412-317-6671 (Toll/International) using conference ID 13762478.


**ABOUT URBAN EDGE PROPERTIES**


Urban Edge Properties is a NYSE listed real estate investment trust focused on owning, managing, acquiring, developing, and redeveloping retail real estate in urban communities, primarily in the Washington, D.C. to Boston corridor. Urban Edge owns 74 properties totaling 16.0 million square feet of gross leasable area.
